pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark-brown irregular polygons with jagged, non-linear boundaries; high edge angularity with sharp pixel gradients in focal areas; internal patch pixels show consistent low-frequency luminance noise.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Lighter interstitial pathways forming a complex graph; junctions typically comprise 3 to 4 nodes; pathway width is non-uniform, narrowing at patch vertices and widening at intersection points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the visible dorsal neck displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated 1D silhouette against the background.
